_comment: A built force pair (v2 Phase 2): `npm run play -- --forces built:data/forces/mixed-12.json`. p1 is a 12-health mixed force, Treefolk the larger share, so its Home is drawn from Swampland; p2 is 12 health of Firewalkers. Each side brings one dragon, one per 24 health or part of it. Nothing here pins a terrain or a dragon, so both are drawn -- add homeTerrain, frontierProposal or dragons to a side to name them. Hand-authored; no importer touches this directory. src/engine/built.test.ts plays it.
